find: The CC area also lists applyVillain: keep one row when assembling.
text: Lesson (from the CC reader's row, merged here on 2026-10-27): a look applied after the toon pass has to know the post-toon material shape (gradientMap, outline uniforms), which couples it to the look pipeline; if v2 wants a hero unit, author it as a wardrobe and palette entry rather than a post-pass. The two readers differed on the mark (port to TypeScript for the variant-pass technique; drop because no game code calls it); the row recommends drop, and Mustafa picks.
ART_DIRECTION.md §7 (:146-154) and :181: implemented, not spawned since D6, reserved for a possible hero unit.

No game caller since D6 (every bot spawns with elite:false); only the Character Lab uses it. A v2 hero unit would be a wardrobe and palette entry, not a post-pass over toon materials. The appearance waits for the look brief.
